nodes.text: Our Work

a.text: Commercial interior work in the Seattle metro typically runs $1.50 to $4.00 per square foot, with exteriors quoted per project after a site assessment. Commercial pricing works differently from residential in a way that catches owners out: the controlling variables are access, scheduling, and surface condition rather than square footage.

a.text: A 10,000 sq ft warehouse with open floor and clear walls can price lower per foot than a 4,000 sq ft occupied office suite requiring evening work, furniture protection, and phased access. When you compare bids, compare the assumptions about access and hours — that is usually where the difference is.

items.q: What is the difference between a commercial painter and an industrial painter?

a.text: Commercial painting covers occupied and public-facing buildings — offices, retail, medical suites, schools, multi-family and common areas. The priorities are appearance, durability under traffic, low odor and fast return-to-service, and working around occupants.
a.html: Commercial painting covers occupied and public-facing buildings — offices, retail, medical suites, schools, multi-family and common areas. The priorities are appearance, durability under traffic, low odor and fast return-to-service, and working around occupants.

a.text: Industrial painting covers manufacturing and infrastructure — structural steel, tanks, plants, containment coatings. It involves specialized surface preparation, protective coating systems, and safety and environmental requirements well beyond commercial work.
a.html: Industrial painting covers manufacturing and infrastructure — structural steel, tanks, plants, containment coatings. It involves specialized surface preparation, protective coating systems, and safety and environmental requirements well beyond commercial work.

a.text: EA Pro Painters is a commercial painting contractor. If your project is genuinely industrial, we will tell you so and point you toward a specialist rather than take work we are not the right fit for.

items.q: Can you work outside our business hours?

a.text: Yes, and for most occupied commercial spaces we recommend it. Evening, overnight, and weekend scheduling means your staff and customers never work around equipment, and you avoid the productivity cost of a disrupted floor.
a.html: Yes, and for most occupied commercial spaces we recommend it. Evening, overnight, and weekend scheduling means your staff and customers never work around equipment, and you avoid the productivity cost of a disrupted floor.

a.text: We also specify low- and zero-VOC coatings for occupied interiors so spaces are usable the following morning without lingering odor — which matters especially in medical, dental, childcare, and food service environments.
a.html: We also specify low- and zero-VOC coatings for occupied interiors so spaces are usable the following morning without lingering odor — which matters especially in medical, dental, childcare, and food service environments.

items.q: Do you carry the insurance and bonding our property management company requires?

a.text: Yes. We maintain general liability, workers' compensation, and bonding, and we issue certificates of insurance naming your entity as additional insured on request — which most property managers and commercial landlords require before a crew is allowed on site.
a.html: Yes. We maintain general liability, workers' compensation, and bonding, and we issue certificates of insurance naming your entity as additional insured on request — which most property managers and commercial landlords require before a crew is allowed on site.

a.text: Send us your insurance requirements with the RFP and we will confirm compliance before bidding rather than discovering a gap after award.
a.html: Send us your insurance requirements with the RFP and we will confirm compliance before bidding rather than discovering a gap after award.

items.q: How do you minimize disruption in an occupied building?

a.text: By phasing. We break the project into zones so only a defined area is out of service at any point, protect and relocate furnishings within each zone, and restore each zone to working condition before moving to the next.
a.html: By phasing. We break the project into zones so only a defined area is out of service at any point, protect and relocate furnishings within each zone, and restore each zone to working condition before moving to the next.

a.text: You get a written phase schedule before we start, a single point of contact for the duration, and daily end-of-shift cleanup — so the space is presentable every morning regardless of where the project stands.

Proper preparation is key to any painting project. At EA Pro Painters we do all the prep work from power and pressure washing, to scraping and sanding. This ensures the surface is ready for painting and allows for better adhesion and finish. We want to make the process easy for our clients so they can focus on their business. Consider EA Pro Painters for your next commercial wall painting project, whether it's small or large-scale, and experience our reliable service.
